what: On a black canvas, short vertical dashes (at 1440 wide: height 30px · thickness 3.75px, width 375→2.5px · 2560→6.5px) stand in rows on twenty-two arched strands and flow along them at .7 slots per second (lower right → upper left). Six are always lit in the accent color, switch off after 1.2s × .7~1.3, and light up anew in other spots. The top and bottom 20% of the plate melt into the background color. The canvas stretches 1440×842 to cover

options.blue: Number of accent dashes lit at once, default 6

note: If the element is not a canvas, a canvas is created inside and fills it completely. Dashes are painted reading --kf-dim, the accent reading --kf-accent, and the background reading --kf-bg. It pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden, and draws a single frame under reduced motion. The line shapes are not the original coordinates but our own curves (twenty-two elliptical arc strands)

from.where: index.html .db-hero (hero canvas — original [data-hero-canvas] omega .7 · emphasis 6 · lifetime 1.2 · record .2 · dash 30/1440)
